methods.adapter_policy: Use existing audited CPD implementation/results only after split/query audit.
methods.important_note: CPD is an algorithmic baseline rather than a single author-official repository. Prefer the CPD implementation/evaluation path distributed with the official fDNC benchmark or the already audited project implementation, and record provenance.

methods.important_note: Official NeurPIR uses population activity together with neuron coordinates: coordinates determine nearest-neighbor ordering and distance-bin embeddings. Do not call the untouched official implementation purely activity-only.

methods.forbidden_changes: official dynamics architecture, embedding parameterization, masking objective, or published hyperparameters
methods.important_note: Use the paper's cross-animal path: fit shared dynamics on outer train, freeze it, then optimize fresh label-free embeddings for unseen validation/test worms.
